privacyPage.title: PRIVACY
paragraphs: Vesper Privacy Policy has been adapted to the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Law No. 13.709/2018, which protects personal data.
This means we are adapting our processes to obtain explicit consent and ensure protection of customer data during collection, storage and use.
In addition to giving users more control over information, the law brings more transparency and legal certainty to everyone involved.

sections.title: ANTI-CORRUPTION PROVISIONS
items: Vesper undertakes to strictly observe and comply with all applicable laws, including Brazilian anti-corruption law and anti-money laundering rules.
Vesper declares and warrants that it is not and will not be involved in any activity or practice that violates anti-corruption laws.
Vesper declares that it has not offered, promised, paid or authorized payment, gifts or anything of value to interested parties to obtain benefits.
All billing documentation must include a detailed invoice describing services rendered or goods purchased.
Failure to comply with anti-corruption laws is considered a serious violation and may immediately terminate any new business relationship.

sections.title: SUPPLIER CODE OF CONDUCT AND ETHICS
items: The supplier undertakes to observe and comply with all applicable laws, including anti-corruption and anti-money laundering legislation.
The supplier declares it is not involved in any activity that violates anti-corruption laws while fulfilling its obligations.
The supplier must promptly notify Vesper in writing of any suspected violation of anti-corruption laws.
The supplier must not commit or be complicit in forced labor, slave labor, compulsory labor or modern forms of slavery.

sections.title: PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION (LGPD)
items: All Vesper employees are trained and sign confidentiality terms regarding Law No. 13.709/2018 (LGPD).
Vesper adopts internal control and personal data protection procedures as established by law.
Photos or videos in the workplace are not allowed without authorization from the company and employees.

sections.title: HUMAN RIGHTS
items: Vesper is committed to respecting, raising awareness, promoting and preventing violations of human rights protected by international treaties.
All employees must promote a work environment that respects cultural diversity, skin color, nationality, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, religion and political belief.
Everyone must prevent and not be complicit in any work performed by children and adolescents under 16 years old.
Vesper maintains permanent communication channels with communities where it operates, promoting dialogue and appropriate engagement.

sections.title: MISCONDUCT
items: Any employee misconduct must be reported directly to company management by email at sap@vesper.ind.br.
